purpose: Evidence Lineage: deterministic backward traversal from an accepted EvidenceRecord to its original DisclosureDocument provenance (EvidenceRecord -> SemanticClaim -> SemanticClaimCandidate -> TextBlock -> DisclosureDocument), plus a minimal forward query (DisclosureDocument -> descendant EvidenceRecord IDs).
